who: Before the clocks stopped, Ms. Odessa ran the Gates Ave stoop like a front office. She scouted every kid on the block and called every foul from her lawn chair.
When the night froze, all that watching turned into something else. Now she sees every move before you make it, and the court in front of her stoop is hers.

lieutenant.name: Lil' Deacon
lieutenant.title: Her Grandson
intro: Lil' Deacon: Grandma said nobody plays on her court unless I say so.
Lil' Deacon: And I don't say so.
defeat: Lil' Deacon: Okay, okay! Go on then. Tell her I said you could hoop.
Lil' Deacon: She shoots it high. Real high. Don't just stand there watching it.

rumors.name: Mr. Hollis
lines: That stoop court used to be the friendliest run in Bed-Stuy.
Since the clocks stopped, the Stoop Queen won't let anybody near it. Her grandson Deacon guards the block.

rumors.name: Tasha
lines: The Queen never gets up. Never. She just throws it from her chair, way up high.
Get close and she'll swat you with a slipper. Don't ask me how I know.

who: The Barker ran the ring-toss on the boardwalk for forty summers. Nobody ever won his game, and nobody ever figured out how.
When the night stopped, the boardwalk lights never went off. His sideshow got bigger, and so did he.

lieutenant.name: Shell Game Sal
lieutenant.title: Keeps The Line Moving
intro: Sal: Step right up! Line's closed. Come back never.
Sal: Unless you can find the ball. Can you find the ball?
defeat: Sal: Alright, alright, you found it. The tent's open.
Sal: Word to the wise: the Barker's got copies of himself. Hit the real one.

rumors.name: Funnel Cake Rosa
lines: The Barker's game is rigged, honey. Always was.
He fakes left, fakes left again, then pulls up from way back.

rumors.name: Coaster Kid
lines: I rode the coaster forty times last night. It never stops now.
Sal runs the line to the Barker's tent. You gotta get past him first.

who: Big Vic collected the toll on the old bridge for thirty years. Paid in quarters, paid in respect.
When the night stopped, the bridge became his body. Brooklyn's King now. Nobody crosses, nobody scores, without paying.

lieutenant.name: E-Z Pass
lieutenant.title: Collector
intro: E-Z Pass: You trying to see the King? That's a toll.
E-Z Pass: Pay up in buckets or bruises.
defeat: E-Z Pass: Fine. Toll's paid. Vic will see you now.
E-Z Pass: He lives in the paint. Pull him out or pay at the rim.

rumors.name: Old Fisher
lines: Every Brooklyn legend has to get past the Toll. Every one.
He plants under the rim like a pylon. Don't drive into him unless he's shook.

rumors.name: Bridge Painter
lines: E-Z Pass works the approach under the arches.
Beat him and the King will hear about it.

who: King Crab worked the fish market docks, hauling crates sideways down the narrow aisles.
When the clocks stopped, the market froze at closing time. He grew a shell and claws to match, and he guards the dock court like a trap.

lieutenant.name: Pincher
lieutenant.title: Dock Boss
intro: Pincher: The Crab don't play strangers.
Pincher: You wanna be a stranger with a broken ankle?
defeat: Pincher: Ay, you can move. Go see the Crab.
Pincher: He walks sideways. Don't stand where he's walking.

rumors.name: Fishmonger Lou
lines: That crab pinches the ball right out your hands. Keep it moving.
He won't shoot from deep. He lives in the post.

rumors.name: Market Kid
lines: Pincher's crew runs the market aisles.
Nobody gets to the dock court without going through them.

who: Silverback was the zoo's oldest resident, and the night watchman's best friend. They'd shoot around after closing.
When the night stopped, the watchman never came back. Silverback broke out looking for him, and he's not in a sharing mood.

lieutenant.name: Zookeeper Jay
lieutenant.title: Has The Keys
intro: Jay: I'm the only one he lets near the gate.
Jay: And I'm not letting you near it.
defeat: Jay: Okay! You're tough. Maybe tough enough.
Jay: He drives. He doesn't stop. Plant your feet and he'll slow down.

rumors.name: Groundskeeper
lines: Silverback plays bully ball. Shoulder down, straight to the rim.
Stay healthy, stand your ground. He bounces off people who don't flinch.

rumors.name: Bird Lady
lines: Jay walks the zoo road with the gate keys.
He thinks he's protecting the big guy. Maybe he is.

who: Grandmaster Boom threw the first block party on Highbridge. Two turntables, one extension cord, a whole borough dancing.
When the night stopped, the party never ended. The Bronx King plays to the beat, and the beat never stops.

lieutenant.name: MC Static
lieutenant.title: Hype Man
intro: MC Static: Who invited YOU to the party?
MC Static: Nobody. That's who.
defeat: MC Static: Alright, you got rhythm. The Grandmaster's waiting.
MC Static: He shoots on the one. Watch his feet, feel the beat.

rumors.name: Breakbeat Bea
lines: Boom pulls up from the elbow every time the bass hits.
Ride the beat and he can't catch you.

rumors.name: Old Head Ray
lines: Hip-hop started here. So did half the moves you know.
MC Static runs the crowd outside the block party.

who: The Express drove the last train out of Roosevelt Ave every night for twenty years. Never late. Never stopped.
When the clocks froze, the last train never came in. Now he IS the train, and he only goes one direction: at the rim.

lieutenant.name: Conductor Cass
lieutenant.title: Stand Clear
intro: Cass: Ticket?
Cass: No ticket, no ride. No ride, no court.
defeat: Cass: Fine. Platform's open. Watch the gap.
Cass: He goes downhill every possession. Be in his way, early.

rumors.name: Night Market Auntie
lines: The Express never pulls up. He drives, every time.
Get your body in front of him and he slows right down.

rumors.name: Turnstile Tony
lines: Conductor Cass rides the platform loop.
She decides who gets on the Express's court.

who: Extra Sauce ran the best cart at the Astoria night market. Lines around the block at three in the morning.
When three in the morning became forever, the line never ended, and neither did the chef.

lieutenant.name: Hot Plate
lieutenant.title: Line Cook
intro: Hot Plate: Kitchen's closed to customers.
Hot Plate: You want in, you gotta take the heat.
defeat: Hot Plate: Okay, chef. Go on back.
Hot Plate: He's crafty. Floaters, fadeaways. Contest the release, not the fake.

rumors.name: Napkin Guy
lines: Sauce has a soft touch. Floaters all night.
Time your hands on the release and you'll mess up his shot.

rumors.name: Delivery Kid
lines: Hot Plate guards the back of the market.
Get past him and the chef will cook for you. Cook you, I mean.

who: Atlas posed under the steel globe for tourist photos every day. Nobody knew he could hoop until the clocks stopped.
Now he carries the world on his back. Queens' King, and the hardest body to move in the five boroughs.

lieutenant.name: Orbit
lieutenant.title: Moon Of The Globe
intro: Orbit: Everybody circles Atlas. Everybody.
Orbit: You're not even in orbit yet.
defeat: Orbit: Alright, you've got gravity. Go.
Orbit: He blocks everything near the rim. Make him come out to you.

rumors.name: Fountain Guard
lines: Atlas won't move off the block. He's too big to move.
Shoot over him from range, or make him dizzy first.

rumors.name: Park Runner
lines: Orbit circles the fairground. He's Atlas's guy.
Beat Orbit and the globe court opens.

who: The Ferryman piloted the St. George boat for forty years. Free fare, always on time.
When the night stopped, so did the ferry, mid-crossing. He came back to shore different. The ride is still free. Getting off costs you.

lieutenant.name: First Mate Mo
lieutenant.title: Checks Tickets
intro: Mo: Boarding's closed.
Mo: The Ferryman doesn't take passengers who can't keep their feet.
defeat: Mo: Alright. You got sea legs. Board.
Mo: He drifts and shoots long. Stay close and stay on deck.

rumors.name: Harbor Pilot
lines: The Ferryman lets you come to him. Patient.
He'll shoot from way out. Close out, hands high.

rumors.name: Seagull Watcher
lines: First Mate Mo keeps watch over the terminal.
Nobody boards without his say.

who: The General was a statue at the old fort for two hundred years. Kids played ball in his shadow every summer.
When the night stopped, he climbed down off his pedestal. Discipline, fundamentals, and no patience for showboats.

lieutenant.name: Sergeant Pike
lieutenant.title: On Guard Duty
intro: Pike: HALT. State your business.
Pike: Wrong answer. Drop and give me twenty buckets.
defeat: Pike: At ease. The General will see you.
Pike: He runs the textbook mid-range. Make him run it with a hand in his face.

rumors.name: Fort Ranger
lines: The General never gambles on defense. Never reaches.
But he closes out hard. Shot fakes work on him.

rumors.name: Reenactor
lines: Sergeant Pike patrols the fort road.
He takes his orders seriously.

who: Everything the city threw away ended up at the landfill. When the clocks stopped, the trash heap stood up.
Staten Island's King is made of every broken backboard and busted ball in New York. He wants it all back, especially rebounds.

lieutenant.name: Scrap
lieutenant.title: Picks Through Everything
intro: Scrap: Everything up here belongs to the King.
Scrap: Including you, now.
defeat: Scrap: Okay! Okay. Take the road up.
Scrap: He crashes the boards like a garbage truck. Box him out.

rumors.name: Truck Driver
lines: The King of the Heap grabs every rebound. Every one.
Miss and he's got it. Make it count.

rumors.name: Recycling Kid
lines: Scrap guards the road up the hill.
Bring him down and the King will notice.

who: For thirty years the Hook pulled bad acts off the stage at Amateur Night. The crowd loved him more than the performers.
When the night stopped, the show never ended. Now he decides who's good enough to stay on the court.

lieutenant.name: Spotlight
lieutenant.title: Stage Manager
intro: Spotlight: You got an act? Show me.
Spotlight: Boo. Get off my stage.
defeat: Spotlight: Okay, the crowd likes you. You're on.
Spotlight: The Hook loves a show. Bore him and you're done.

rumors.name: Usher
lines: The Hook has the best handles uptown. All flash.
He steps back for threes. Don't give him room.

rumors.name: Marquee Painter
lines: Spotlight works the line outside the theater.
Win him over and you'll get your shot on stage.

who: The Coop King kept pigeons on the Heights rooftops. A thousand birds that always came home.
When the night stopped, the birds never landed. He became the flock: everywhere at once, quick hands, gone before you look.

lieutenant.name: Feathers
lieutenant.title: Rooftop Runner
intro: Feathers: The roof is his. The sky is his.
Feathers: You can't even fly.
defeat: Feathers: Fine. The coop's up there.
Feathers: He'll take the ball off you if you hold it. Keep it moving.

rumors.name: Bodega Uncle
lines: That Coop King has the quickest hands in the city.
Don't dribble near him. He'll pick you clean.

rumors.name: Stoop Kid
lines: Feathers runs the rooftops for him.
He's the one you gotta beat first.

who: Every legend in this city came through the Mecca, and every one of them got walked by High Rise.
When the night stopped, the court's greatest player grew as tall as his legend. Uptown's King. Turnarounds from another floor.

lieutenant.name: Elevator
lieutenant.title: Goes Up
intro: Elevator: Going up? Not you.
Elevator: You gotta be this tall to play the Mecca.
defeat: Elevator: Alright, small fry. Doors are open.
Elevator: He blocks everything up top. Get him moving sideways.

rumors.name: Mecca Regular
lines: High Rise is the best player who ever lived uptown. Maybe anywhere.
Long arms. He'll block you from three steps away.

rumors.name: Fence Sitter
lines: Elevator guards the walk to the park court.
Nobody plays the Mecca without his nod.

who: The cage court downtown was where the toughest runs in the city happened. No refs, no fouls, just the fence.
Chain Link was the fence. When the clocks stopped, he woke up and started keeping score.

lieutenant.name: Padlock
lieutenant.title: No Calls
intro: Padlock: The cage is invite only.
Padlock: And nobody invited you.
defeat: Padlock: You can take a hit. Go on in.
Padlock: He'll muscle you off the ball. Strength matters in there.

rumors.name: Courier
lines: Chain Link plays with no calls. All contact.
Get bodied too much and he takes the ball. Keep your feet.

rumors.name: Street Vendor
lines: Padlock watches the cage entrance.
He's a suit with a key ring. Don't let that fool you.

who: Suspension is the bridge itself, cable and steel, a hundred years of holding the city together.
When the night stopped, the bridge started holding court. Long reach, high arcs, and it never gets tired.

lieutenant.name: Rivet
lieutenant.title: Ironworker
intro: Rivet: Nobody walks the span tonight.
Nobody.
defeat: Rivet: Fine. Watch the planks up there.
Rivet: It shoots high and long. Close out on the release.

rumors.name: Cyclist
lines: Suspension spaces you out and shoots over you.
Crowd the release and it misses.

rumors.name: Toll Booth Ghost
lines: Rivet works the approach to the span.
Beat him and the bridge opens.

who: Prime Time was the biggest screen in Midtown. Every highlight in the city played on him.
When the night stopped, he wanted to be the highlight. Deep threes for the replay, crossovers for the crowd.

lieutenant.name: Boom Mic
lieutenant.title: Floor Producer
intro: Boom Mic: We're live in five!
Boom Mic: And you're not on the call sheet.
defeat: Boom Mic: Ratings went up. Go on, you're on air.
Boom Mic: He shoots from the logo. Don't give him room.

rumors.name: Tourist
lines: Prime Time hits threes from way, way out.
Every shot is for the camera. Make him miss on TV.

rumors.name: Billboard Guy
lines: Boom Mic runs the stage door.
Get past him and you're in the show.

who: Everybody said there was a gator in the sewers. Everybody was right.
When the night stopped, he came up to the downtown court. He hides low and grabs everything you drop.

lieutenant.name: Manhole
lieutenant.title: Lives Down There
intro: Manhole: Psst. Down here.
Manhole: Your ball's mine now.
defeat: Manhole: Okay, okay! The grate's open.
Manhole: The Gator snaps up every loose ball. Don't drop it.

rumors.name: Sanitation Worker
lines: That gator is real, and he's got the quickest jaws downtown.
He's always going for the ball. Every loose one.

rumors.name: Subway Busker
lines: Manhole lives under the street by the court.
He'll pick your pocket. Beat him first.

who: The Gargoyle sat on the tallest spire in Midtown for a century, watching the city play.
When the night stopped, he flew down to join in. High-release jumpers that ride the wind, and he swoops in to block.

lieutenant.name: Window Washer Wes
lieutenant.title: Hangs Around
intro: Wes: Nobody goes up to the spire.
Wes: Not today. Not ever.
defeat: Wes: Alright, you can climb. The roof court's up there.
Wes: The wind pushes his shots. And yours. Watch the flags.

rumors.name: Doorman
lines: The Gargoyle shoots from up high, and the wind carries it.
He swoops down to block. Pump fake, then go.

rumors.name: Rooftop Gardener
lines: Wes works the scaffolds on the tower.
He's the only way up.

who: Midnight was the greatest to ever do it. When his last game ended, he couldn't let it go.
So he stopped the clock at the Garden. Every legend's hype flows up to him now. To bring the sun back, somebody has to beat him.
Down in the tunnels under Bed-Stuy, one rat dragged a slice of pizza down the subway stairs and became a legend.
The Pizza Rat King rules the sewers now, and he does not share.
Pops was a legend once, before your time. He taught half the old heads in the city how to play.
He's been waiting for someone good enough to ask him for one more run.
